newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Apator revises up 1996 net to PLN 4.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Apator revises up 1996 net to PLN 4.8 mln.

text.p: Poland's gauge maker Apator SA, which on January 27 starts its public offering, revised up its earlier 1996 net profit estimate to 4.8 million zlotys, the company said in a statement on Friday.

Apator said better-than-expected December sales of high-margin products and a fall in financial costs allowed the company to exceed by 20 percent its earlier prediction of a four-million-zloty net profit.
Apator, based in the northern city of Torun, is offering up to 800,000 new shares and about 600,000 existing shares in a public subscription scheduled for January 27-31.
The company plans to start trading on the Warsaw bourse's main market in March.
